stages.title: Local Gold evidence audit
stages.detail: Audited 608 saved calls: result labels agree under legacy assumptions; 45 lack prices. Source timestamps remain unverified.

stages.detail: Historical 1H reach research compares the existing L2L distance with its 0.5 equivalent using the same frozen directional calls.

stages.title: XAU/USD factor assessment

stages.title: Call qualifying gate
stages.detail: Only starts after data integrity, calibration, risk sequencing, and out-of-sample gates pass.
